title: RolePack manifest
description: Declarative role package manifest. A role pack is data and templates only: it never grants execution or publish rights. requested_capabilities is a requirements declaration, not an authorization credential. Package-relative paths must stay inside the package root; the loader additionally rejects traversal and out-of-root symlinks.

schema_version.description: Version of the RolePack manifest format.

name.description: Package name, unique within a workspace after installation.

version.description: Package version, semver shaped. Version plus content hash enters every BootstrapBundle and audit record.

requires_protocol.description: RoleDock protocol version the pack was written against.

packagePath.description: Package-root-relative POSIX path. Must start with an alphanumeric character, which rejects absolute paths, drive letters, './' forms and backslashes; '..' segments are rejected by pattern. Deeper traversal and symlink escape checks happen in the installer (P1).

capabilityName.description: Namespaced capability request such as 'documents.read'. Names are free-form in the protocol; the workspace owner's policy decides what is granted.

template.description: Path to the document template file inside the pack.

visibility.description: Requested default visibility: private (owning instance), role (owning role primary sessions), project (all roles in the workspace), public (cleared for sharing outside the workspace). Actual access is enforced by the workspace policy.

schema.description: Path to a JSON Schema file inside the pack used to validate outputs of that kind.

roleDefinition.description: One role. Role ids are pack-local identifiers; the core contains no role name enumeration of any kind.

instructions.description: Path to the role instruction document inside the pack.
